name: XCC_STREAM_BALANCES_T
description: This temporary table contains budgetary control balances impacted by budget imports and transactions that have passed budgetary control validation but have not yet been updated to the budgetary control balances cubes. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CUBE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the budgetary control balances cube with pending updates.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the control budget with pending updates.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the budget period with pending updates.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Identifies the budget account with pending updates.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
